question: The deployed work-items store runs as role `mctl-api` (database `mctl-api` on shared-pg, via the AUDIT_DB_URL fallback), but every role-name check in mctl-api (^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$) refuses a hyphen, so WithWorkItemsRole("mctl-api") cannot succeed. Which work-items role should the Glovo migration grant and the runtime use?
reason: The issue asks to use the existing work-items runtime role and record its final name before the migration runs; the existing name is not admissible to ApplySchema/ApplyGlovoApprovalSchema as written.

options: Create a dedicated role mctl_api_workitems and set an explicit WORK_ITEMS_DB_URL on database mctl-api
Keep mctl-api and change the role handling to quote identifiers and admit hyphens
